biotools.summary: MicrobiomeNet is a database integrating microbial associations with their metabolic profiles to facilitate mechanistic insights. It contains microbial associations and genome-scale metabolic models (GEMs) covering thousands of species, enabling users to explore interactions and compare metabolic profiles.
